requestedToolPolicy: read only named frozen candidates; no other filesystem, memory, network, tools or writes

proposal.old: reckon step(state : Sequence) -> Sequence = finish_step(state, clamp_x(x(state) + input.move + input.speed), y(state) + next_velocity(state), next_velocity(state))
proposal.new: reckon step(state : Sequence) -> Sequence = finish_step(state, clamp_x(x(state) + input.move * input.speed), y(state) + next_velocity(state), next_velocity(state))
proposal.diagnosis: Horizontal displacement adds direction and speed instead of multiplying them. Multiplication preserves zero and negative directions, then clamps the resulting position to the existing bounds.

With downward-positive coordinates, negative positions are airborne. Landing must trigger at or past ground zero so the existing landing branch resets vertical position and velocity while preserving airborne motion.

The nonnegative collection check allows repeated pickup after reaching the star threshold. Requiring collected to equal zero permits one pickup, keeps score at zero or one, and leaves terminal enemy-stop behavior unchanged.
